excerpt.en: The material composition of this asteroid differs significantly from its neighbors. It likely has a different origin than the other bodies of this asteroid belt, and should be investigated more closely.

texts.zh: 虽然这个真相让人有些难以接受，但所有的证据都表明[From.GetName]这颗小行星是一颗粪化石小行星——也就是某种巨大生命体的粪便化石形成的行星。其存在时间大概已经有十亿年了，因此化石的原成分也逐渐积淀成了矿藏。我们的科学家十分困惑究竟是什么样的生物才能留下这样的庞然大物。
texts.en: Although it is difficult to accept, all indications point towards asteroid [From.GetName] being a coprolite - a piece of fossilized feces from some kind of massive life form. It appears to be almost a billion years old, and much of the fossil's original organic composition has been replaced by mineral deposits. Our scientists are baffled as to what kind of creature could have produced something like this.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗小行星的名称。
note.en: In the game, this asteroid's name appears here.

texts.zh: 在[From.GetName]没有大气圈的地表之上，我们发现了几种似乎是水生生物的化石。有证据表明，这一圈环绕的小行星带是一颗破碎的行星形成的，因此化石的发现也证实了这一理论。从这些化石不难发现，这颗行星上曾有生命存在，而且也有水的存在。
texts.en: Fossils from what appears to be several species of aquatic animals have been found on the barren and airless surface of [From.GetName]. There are indications that the surrounding asteroid belt was created from the remains of a shattered planet, and these findings seem to confirm that theory. Judging by the fossils, the planet supported life and was at least partially covered by water.

label.zh: 真遗憾他们没能继续进化下去。
label.en: Unfortunate that they couldn't evolve further.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗小行星的名称。
note.en: In the game, this asteroid's name appears here.

texts.zh:
[Root.GetName]船员报告称，有个一开始被探测器判为小行星的物体其实是一颗巨大的漂浮垃圾球。它由各种载具，火箭，以及有害物质（其中许多具有放射性）的破损残骸组成，似乎是某个处于早期太空时代的未知外星帝国的废弃物。

这个帝国似乎习惯于向太空抛弃垃圾，将危险的工业废弃物抛向轨道而不是在星球上丢弃。辐射测量显示这些废弃物已有数百万年历史，并且自离开其未知来源起几乎一直都在虚空中漂流。

科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]注意到这块漂浮垃圾中的某些材料非常稀有，并且可以精炼成有用的资源。
texts.en:
The [Root.GetName] crew report that what first appeared to our scanners as an asteroid is in fact a gigantic, floating ball of junk. Comprised of the broken remains of various vehicles, rockets and hazardous materials (many of them radioactive), the junk ball seems to be the detritus of an unknown alien nation in the early space age.

It would appear this nation was an interstellar litterer, ejecting dangerous industrial waste into orbit rather than disposing of it planetside. Radiometric dating suggests these remains are millions of years old, and have been floating through space from an unknown point of origin for most of that time.

Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] notes that some of the materials found on this floating junk heap are quite rare, and could be refined into useful resources.

summary.text:
# 未知起源 / Unknown Origin

- 分类 Category：深空异闻 Exploration · 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-13（已审阅 reviewed）
- 来源 Sources：common/anomalies/00_anomaly_categories.txt:33; events/anomaly_events_1.txt:15 (anomaly.1); events/anomaly_events_1.txt:146 (anomaly.15); events/distant_stars_events_1.txt:7265 (distar.225)

## 如何开始 How it starts

小行星可能生成（1级，权重3）。

Can spawn on an asteroid (level 1, weight 3).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

anomaly.1“粪化石小行星”（标本 coprolite，d_society_3 矿藏；星球有战略资源时权重为0）、anomaly.15“小行星化石”（每月社会研究，标本 asteroid_fossils；演化掠食者另有 DNA 选项）与 distar.225“垃圾球”（《遥远繁星》：基础权重0，拥有 DLC 时 +1；星球有战略资源时权重为0；合金矿藏，上古遗物时10个小型遗物，pop_lcluster_event）。

anomaly.1 "Coprolite Asteroid" (specimen coprolite, d_society_3 deposit; weight 0 if the planet has a strategic resource), anomaly.15 "Asteroid Fossils" (monthly society research, specimen asteroid_fossils; Evolutionary Predators get an extra DNA option) and distar.225 "Junk Ball" (Distant Stars: base weight 0, +1 with the DLC; weight 0 if the planet has a strategic resource; alloy deposit, 10 minor artifacts with Ancient Relics, pop_lcluster_event).

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

三个结果互斥：无战略资源且有《遥远繁星》时各约1/3；无该 DLC 时 anomaly.1 与 15 各50%；有战略资源时只会得到 anomaly.15。

The three results are exclusive: about 1/3 each without a strategic resource and with Distant Stars; without the DLC anomaly.1 and 15 are 50% each; with a strategic resource only anomaly.15.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

distar.225 需要《遥远繁星》。

distar.225 needs Distant Stars.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

已核对。草稿显示 anomaly.1 为 p=0.50*、distar.225 为 p=0.00*，均为被修改的基础权重，已用互斥组说明。

Checked. The draft shows anomaly.1 as p=0.50* and distar.225 as p=0.00*, both modified base weights, documented with an exclusive group.
